title: Video follow-up, hip, flare after gardening

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi Carl, let's do this on video. What's changed since last week?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I did a lot of gardening Saturday and the hip flared. Pain is 7 out of 10 yesterday, and 5 this morning.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Any new numbness down the leg?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No numbness. It's a deep ache in the groin when I walk.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Were you able to do the sit-to-stand exercises this week?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Only once, after the flare. I stopped for a few days.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: That's understandable. Do you have trouble putting on socks or getting in the car?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Getting in the car is hard. Socks I can do.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: I can't check motion over video, so I'd like to see you in person.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: until we see you, rest the hip from gardening and walk only on flat ground. I'm also dropping the lunges for now.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay. When can I garden again?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: We'll decide that in person. The visit is Wednesday at 10.

expectedFacts.statement: Pain 7 out of 10 yesterday, 5 this morning
Gardening on Saturday triggered a flare
Deep ache in the groin when walking
Sit-to-stand exercises done only once this week
Getting in the car is hard
Rest from gardening, walk on flat ground only
